mods.name: Alarielle-Morathi expansion (ATB)
mods.summary: Work-in-progress add-on for Alarielle, Temptation's Bloom: a turn 1 mission to capture Alarielle for players starting as Morathi, Warriors of Chaos or Daemons of Chaos, with a 22-part capture scene, a later visit scene and three handmaidens for Morathi's faction.

downloads.name: Alarielle_Morathi_expansion.pack
downloads.description: Early test build posted in #kerberos-updates on 2026-11-15 (22.6 MB)

relations.note: Its script uses ATB's Alarielle (character, corruption stage, dilemma queue); load it alongside the normal Alarielle mod list.
With any version of Readman's UUU the three handmaidens spawned at the end of the scene get the corrupted models.

knownIssues: Early test build (2026-11-15): the text of the follow-up scene, in which Morathi visits Alarielle in Avelorn, is still blank.
The mission does not spawn when playing Alarielle or the Daemons of Slaanesh: as Slaanesh you own N'Kari and the story has you hiding from Alarielle, so war declarations on her faction are blocked.
The mission aborts if another faction kills Alarielle and is issued again when she recovers.
installNotes: For players starting as Morathi, Warriors of Chaos (Archaon, Be'lakor, Azazel, Sigvald) or a Daemon Prince the mission comes on turn 1. As Miao Ying it needs MrDustV's play-as-Miao compatibility pack for ATB (posted in the ATB channel) and comes after her corruption stage 3.

Completing the mission gives a permanent +200 relation between Alarielle and Morathi, whoever plays; about five turns later a scene in Avelorn follows, and its end spawns three level 20 handmaidens for Morathi's faction.

openQuestions: No image: the previews in the post are explicit scene art.
